summary: Vector transform helper: builds a 4x4 transform into the local v17 array by selecting up to three optional matrix inputs a6/a7/a8 via an 8-case jump-table switch (global 0x00526C88), inverting or composing them with F_4x4MatrixInversion / F_8SIMDMatrixPackedFloatOperation, then transforms an input vector into a3 through F_4DVectorTransform. When a5 is non-null the input is first blended toward a4 using 3DNow! reciprocal/scale math with packed-float constants (globals 0x005AF980/0x005AF988/0x005AF998); otherwise a4 is transformed directly. Returns a3.

operations.description: Switch on (a6 != 0) | (2 * ((a7 != 0) | (2 * (a8 != 0)))); the 8-case dispatch (8-way jump table at global 0x00526C88) selects which of a6/a7/a8 supply the matrix input and whether compose is needed.
Case 0: sub_522B22 builds an identity/default matrix into local v17.
Cases 1/2/4: F_4x4MatrixInversion inverts the single supplied input (a6, a7, or a8 respectively) into v17.

Cases 3/5/6/7: F_8SIMDMatrixPackedFloatOperation composes the supplied matrix inputs (a6/a7/a8) into v17; case 7 composes twice, and cases 3/5/6 then fall through to an extra F_4x4MatrixInversion of v17 (LABEL_11).
Guard a5 != 0 selects the blend path (compute a weighted mix between a4 and a5) versus the direct transform of a4.

Blend math: reciprocal of the a5 scale via _m_pfrcp/_m_pfrcpit1/_m_pfrcpit2, differences between a4 and a5 quads, and packed-float scale/one/sign constants read from globals 0x005AF980, 0x005AF988 and 0x005AF998 to normalize the interpolated vector component.
Write the blended component into a3: a3->m64_u64 receives the transformed first quad (sign-flipped via pxor), a3[1].m64_i32[0] receives the integer-converted second component.
F_4DVectorTransform(a3, a3|a4, v17) applies the composed/inverted transform to the (optionally blended) input vector, storing into a3.
Return the output vector pointer a3.
